DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City JUL 19 2021 http:/Awm.dilq.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 95 s. 2021 ATTY. DULCE H. REBANAL Provincial Administrator Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Laguna Dear Atty. Rebanal: This has reference to your letter dated 14 May 2021, requesting this Department's legal opinion relative to the Grant of Time Allowances to Persons Deprived of Liberty. The following are the facts as culled from your letter: "At present, the Laguna Provincial Jail is being headed by Executive Assistant III, CSUPT. Norman V. Pinion (RET). Our agency has yet to appoint a person for the permanent position as we are still in the process of rigorously assessing applicants, given the complexities of jail operations and the competence needed to ensure highly efficient and effective management of the office. Relatively, the Laguna Provincial Jail, through CSUPT. Pinion (RET) received a letter from CTSSUPT Albert C. Manalo, OIC, Inmate Document and Processing Division of the Bureau of Corrections, dated March 31, 2021, citing in part that only the Warden can grant time allowances and an Executive Assistant is not one of those authorized officials to grant GCTA and other time allowances. In a similar letter from Mr. Aries M. Navarro, Chief Probation and Parole Office of the Laguna Parole and Probation Office, dated march 26, 2021, he also pointed out this matter, citing further that the grant of time allowances of CSUPT. Pinion as a mere Executive Assistant might affect the validity of the GCTA granted and is being granted to our inmates." Hence, arose the following questions, to wit: I. Since the law and the implementing rules and regulations explicitly states that it is only the Warden (in cases of Provincial Jail) who grants the time allowance, who has the legal authority to grant the same in case the position of the Provincial Warden has not yet been filled up? and;

2. Can the Provincial Governor or any competent person by a special order be authorized to grant and sign time allowances of qualified inmates in the Laguna Provincial Jail, the same being a unit under his office? In reply thereto, we deem it apt to address herein queries in one discussion as they are interrelated. Section 5 of Republic Act No. 105921 is categorical when it provides, thus: "Section 5. Article 99 of the same Act is hereby further amended to read as follows:" "ART. 99. Who grants time allowances. — Whenever lawfully justified, the Director of the Bureau of Corrections, the Chief of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology and/or the Warden of a provincial, district, municipal or city jail shall grant allowances for good conduct. Such allowances once granted shall not be revoked." The aforequoted provision is unequivocal that it is only the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology chief, and/or the Warden of a provincial, district, municipal or city jail who are authorized to grant time allowances. The law did not contemplate a situation in which the position of the aforementioned persons authorized to grant time allowances is not filled up. Accordingly, this Department opines that the Provincial Governor or any competent person for that matter, is bereft of authority to grant and sign time allowances of inmates. The remedy therefore, is the expeditious filling up post of Warden in accordance with pertinent laws/rules and procedures. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: NGAN Under cretary for Local Government cc: DIRECTOR ARIEL O. IGLESIA CESC) DILG-Region lv-A CALABARZON 3ra Floor Andenson Bldg., Highway, Parian City Calamba, Laguna LLLS/27 1 An Act Amending Articles 29, 94, 97, 98 and 99 of Act No. 3815, as Amended, otherwise known as the Revised Penal Code
